Class AlgoSecurityEligibility

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoSecurityEligibility
@Service public class AlgoSecurityEligibility extends Object
Excludes margin/leveraged instruments and securities that ended before a strategy opens from new assignments.
